title: Working Student - Manufacturing Support
description:
Back to jobs Working Student - Manufacturing Support Munich | Hybrid Apply Your Role Want to help a space tech company open its new home and a facility where satellites will be built? As our Working Student in Project Support, you’ll join the team running the launch of M-Plaza and our new manufacturing facility in Munich. You’ll work with Operations, Engineering, Facilities and external partners to keep a complex, fast-moving project on track. You’ll take on real tasks from day one: tracking milestones, coordinating vendors and contractors, organising moves and opening events, and keeping everyone informed about what’s happening and when. This facility is where our thermal payloads will be built and tested, so your work directly supports our mission. Key responsibilities Support the project lead with planning and tracking the M-Plaza and manufacturing facility launch, keeping timelines, milestones and to-do lists current Coordinate with internal teams, contractors, suppliers and building management on deliveries, installations, inspections and handovers Prepare agendas, minutes and follow-ups for project meetings, and make sure action items get done Keep project documentation, budgets and procurement trackers accurate and organised Help plan the move into the new space, including workspace setup, equipment, access and onboarding of teams Support the facility’s operational readiness, including documentation for safety, compliance and clean room requirements Help organise the opening and launch activities, including internal announcements, visitor tours and events with partners and stakeholders Keep the wider team updated on progress through regular updates and presentations Job requirements About you Required: You’re currently enrolled at a university or Hochschule in Germany and available for up to 20 hours per week during the semester Strong organisational skills and attention to detail: you enjoy keeping many moving parts in order Clear, proactive communication, and the confidence to follow up with internal teams and external partners A hands-on, solution-oriented attitude: you’re happy to switch between spreadsheets and on-site coordination Good working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint (or similar tools) Comfort in a fast-paced scale-up: you keep priorities clear and adapt when things change Excellent written and spoken English and German Able to work from our Munich site at least 2 days a week, with flexibility around key project milestones Nice to Have: First experience in project management, operations, facilities, event planning or a similar role (an internship, part-time job or student society role all count) Studies in business, engineering, industrial engineering, project management or a related field Interest in manufacturing, clean room environments or aerospace Experience with project management tools such as Jira, Asana, MS Project or Monday German language skills, which are useful when working with local contractors and authorities Why join constellr? High-Impact National Security Mission: Be part of an ambitious mission to launch the world’s first commercial thermal infrared constellation, delivering sovereign-grade "behavioural" intelligence from space to close critical blind spots for defence, intelligence, and maritime surveillance agencies. Fast-Paced "New Space" Innovation: Work at the leading edge of a rapidly evolving defence sector. By leveraging modern, agile New Space methodologies, you will help design, build, and deploy dual-use thermal payloads into operational orbit at a speed and scale that traditional aerospace models simply cannot match. Broad Interdisciplinary Exposure: Accelerate your professional growth by collaborating daily with a diverse, international cohort of astrophysicists, software developers, and defence-system engineers. Inclusive & Scientific Culture: Join a high-trust team deeply committed to diversity, inclusion, and scientific excellence, where academic curiosity is paired with high autonomy and a flat hierarchy. Financial Upside & Well-being: Benefit from a Virtual Share Option Plan (VSOP) for permanent employees, giving you a true stake in the company's growth, alongside highly flexible hybrid working models.
